problem: Traditional 'prompt-as-puppeteer' workflows force humans to spell out every step, limiting scale and creativity.
solution: Give the agent tools plus a high-level goal and let it decide orchestration. Humans supply guard-rails (10%) while agent handles execution (87%).
when: Complex multi-step tasks with unclear sequence
Agent has necessary tools and capabilities
Human oversight available for critical decisions
pros: Scales to complex tasks without step-by-step prompting
